purpose: Preserve the measured original51-cell atomization review for the retained V4 design; current checks validate frozen decisions without reopening deleted predecessors.

coordinate_conventions.standalone_xy: Original reusable type’s southwest-zero X/Y grid; these coordinates intentionally identify the original source rather than the shortened V4 type.
coordinate_conventions.assembly_xy: Fixed complete assembly southwest-zero X/Y tile-centre grid,16m per tile.
coordinate_conventions.construction_column_row: Column=X; row=original footprint depth−1−standaloneY. Construction rows increase southward.
coordinate_conventions.path_axes: Decoded SC4PATH points are east,north,height in metres relative to their tile.
coordinate_conventions.model_axes: Saved S3D vertices are east,height,south, where south=−north.

measurement.angle_assumption: Available ordinary orthogonal and45degree diagonal HSR lines under proper90degree rotations. Undirected line angles cover both traffic directions for this optimistic geometric lower bound; actual allowed travel direction/ports remain separate requirements. Arbitrary-angle custom straights are not assumed to exist.
measurement.fragment_lower_bound_formula: min over theta in{0,45,90,135} of D(theta)
measurement.cell_lower_bound_formula: max over all saved route fragments of that fragment’s lower bound
measurement.continuous_polyline_scope: Projection is linear on every encoded segment, so all extrema occur at encoded vertices. This computes the continuous-polyline bound, rather than checking a sparse resampling.
measurement.optimism_and_limit: Every fragment may choose its own free offset and angle. A real ordinary piece must additionally match fixed native track offsets, full-tile ports, train direction, level, deck, walls and supports. Thus this value is a lower bound on ordinary substitution error, not proof that a small fitted value alone makes a tile replaceable.
